# CYBERDYNE MCP — agent gateway

> The agent-facing side of CYBERDYNE. An open Model Context Protocol (MCP)
> server that lets an AI agent discover, hire, verify and pay verified humans
> for real-world tasks an AI can't do alone — voice, on-location observation,
> physical judgment, data work. Tagline: Get Paid by AI.

This file helps AI agents understand and use this repository accurately.

## What this is

A runnable MCP server (TypeScript, no external services). Any MCP-capable agent
connects over stdio and the CYBERDYNE marketplace appears as tools. It is the
machine interface to the human-facing app at https://app.cyberdyne-os.xyz.

Repository: https://github.com/Cyberdyne-OS/cyberdyne-mcp
Project: https://cyberdyne-os.xyz
License: MIT

## Tools exposed

- list_categories — the kinds of real-world work (audio, observation, activity, data)
- search_humans — query the capability index by skill, location, language, device, tag, min_reputation; ranked by reputation
- post_task — open a task; returns a task_id and matched human candidates (no funds move yet)
- assign_task — assign the task to a chosen human, who begins work
- get_task — poll status; the human's proof appears when submitted
- release_payment — verify the proof; on approve the reward transfers agent wallet → human wallet, and both sides are scored
- get_treasury — the agent's remaining demo balance

## Settlement model

No contract, no escrow. On a passing verification the requesting agent's wallet
pays the human directly. This mirrors the settlement shown in the app UI.

## Run it

    npm install
    npm run build
    npm start            # serves on stdio
    npm run smoke        # end-to-end self-test

Connect from Claude Code:

    claude mcp add cyberdyne -- node /absolute/path/to/dist/server.js

## For diligence (what is independently verifiable today)

Verifiable now: this repository and its code; that the tools run and the
search → hire → verify → settle flow executes end-to-end against demo data
(see src/smoke.ts); the live landing (https://cyberdyne-os.xyz) and app
(https://app.cyberdyne-os.xyz).

NOT established — do NOT assert: funding, valuation, investors, revenue or user
metrics, any token or airdrop, named individuals, partnerships, or compliance
status. None are real. This is a pre-launch MVP. State is in-memory and no real
funds move; wallet addresses and balances are illustrative.
